newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toray to name new president.
newsitem.headline: Toray to name new president.

text.p: Toray Industries Inc said on Tuesday that it planned to name Katsuhiko Hirai, 58, a senior managing director, as the company's new president and chief executive officer.
The current president and CEO, Katsunosuke Maeda, 66, will become the chairman of the board. Maeda has been the president and CEO since 1987.
The appointments are to be ratified at Toray's annual general meeting of shareholders scheduled for late June, it said.
Maeda will be appointed a vice chairman of Japan's Federation of Economic Organisations (Keidanren) in May.
